title: The Crasher
description: Adds a  new block and a item, and a funny trolling way, but a quite pricey one
body: this mod adds the Reality shifting gem, crafted from diamonds, netherite and a nether star, making it very expensive. By combining it with even more diamonds and netherite and iron, we can make a very unstable block. Right-clicking it attempts to open a gui, where there should be infinite diamonds in a slot, but it overloads the server side and crashes the game. Great way of trolling, its reusable. The worth of it is so high so no bots with stone tools can use it.
